text:
hana: Ran into a flaky onboarding flow in the new sampleapp today. Steps:
1) Start a streaming generation to persist a user draft
2) Force token rotation (short-lived test key)
3) Upstream responds 429 during the rotation
4) Result: duplicate draft rows in DB

mike: Hmm, is this because the Node SDK retries the HTTP wrapper and replays the chunk events?

ravi: Correct. Node's retry wrapper will replay the last unacked chunk without attaching any idempotency metadata for the app-level write. Go SDK aborts the stream and surface an error. Parity mismatch.

sophia: Do we already require Idempotency-Key for writes? I thought our create endpoints enforce that.
\hana: We do, but streaming write helpers in sampleapp bypass the high-level REST client and thus miss the header. It's an SDK/sampleapp integration gap.
\mike: Quick fixes we discussed: 1) sampleapp should add automatic idempotency header at the HTTP transport layer for any write operation from examples; 2) SDKs should include a deterministic replay-marker header (x-client-replay-hash) when resuming after transient auth failures.

ravi: Also, introduce jitter delta on retries that parse Retry-After. Right now multiple clients retry in lockstep during short rotation windows. Suggest sleep = RetryAfter + rand(0, min(2s, RetryAfter*0.1)).

sophia: For UX, could we show a clearer error in the onboarding flow: "Your session rotated — some actions may have been retried. Check drafts for duplicates"? That helps customers notice while we fix SDK parity.
\hana: I'll open a PR in sampleapp to add the transport-level idempotency wrapper and a unit test that simulates 429+rotation.
\mike: I'll coordinate with SDK leads to add the replay-hash header in Node and match it in Go. We should include a spec: header name, value format (sha256 hex of last-ack+timestamp), and privacy constraints.
\ravi: Telemetry: emit an event "retry_resume_attempt" with fields: sdk, replay_hash, outcome (success|duplicate_detected). Hash only, no payload.
\build-bot: deploy queued: sampleapp/idempotency-transport v2 -> staging at 1967801200 :rocket:
\sophia: Nice. Longer-term: doc update in devex guide about "Safe streaming replays" and a sample pattern for background writes (use server-side dedupe keyed by idempotency key).
\hana: I'll file three follow-ups: PR for sampleapp, parity PRs for Node+Go SDKs, and an e2e test that asserts single-copy semantics when simulating token rotation.
\mike: Thanks. Let's also add a lint check in CI that fails if any example call to /writes lacks an idempotency header. Small change but high ROI.
\hana: Agree. I'll add the lint in the sampleapp PR.
